.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd

children.role_hint: Main single-ended OTA signal-path core. It uses complementary NMOS and PMOS input devices driven by vin and vip, with vo as the single-ended output. M5 receives the PMOS bias ib_sink, while M2 is locally self-biased from internal node net2.
children.role_description: Main single-ended OTA signal-path core. It uses complementary NMOS and PMOS input devices driven by vin and vip, with vo as the single-ended output. M5 receives the PMOS bias ib_sink, while M2 is locally self-biased from internal node net2.
children.netlist:
.subckt complementary_self_biased_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_self_biased_ota_core
